title:
SB 1786 - This act authorizes the City of St. Joseph to annex an airport owned and operated by such city, regardless of whether the boundaries of such airport are contiguous and compact to the existing corporate limits of the city.

	This act is identical to HB 2818 (2026).
TRISTAN BENSON, JR.
